claim: One click opens a filled owner workspace with three offers, two client links, and three requests.
sandbox: fresh browser context; click once from /; assert seeded owner rows, edit an offer, and reset

claim: Demo changes stay in browser memory and never enter the real request inbox.
sandbox: fresh browser context; submit in sample client view and compare the authenticated real inbox

claim: A first business can create its owner workspace, name its catalog, add an offer, create a client link, and rename the catalog.
sandbox: fresh server and test-only Entra identity; complete first-owner setup through the browser

claim: Sociobot Microsoft Entra External ID is the only owner sign-in method.
sandbox: assert the configured authority and client ID, exercise redirect, reject the legacy password header, and find no password input

claim: Prices require an owner-created private client link that can expire or be revoked.
sandbox: create a 40-character link, read it, advance the test clock beyond expiry, revoke it, and assert both closed states return 410

claim: A valid client request appears in the owner inbox.
sandbox: submit known contact details, note, quantity, and offer through a private catalog; assert the same record in the authenticated inbox

claim: A submitted request stores the name, email, phone, reference, note, and selected offers.
sandbox: submit every disclosed field; read the authenticated record and SQLite row; assert each retained value

claim: Owners can change each request status to new, quoted, or closed.
sandbox: create a real request; change its status through the authenticated owner UI; reload and assert the saved status

claim: Owners can export request rows as CSV and PDF.
sandbox: create a known request; parse real and demo PDFs; assert pages plus reference, client, and offer text in CSV and PDF

claim: Owners choose which offers each private client link can open.
sandbox: create two links with different assignments and compare returned offer IDs

claim: One catalog can contain fixed-price offers and offers that need a quote.
sandbox: select one of each in the sample client catalog and assert both in the sample inbox row

claim: Owners can edit, archive, restore, and delete offers.
sandbox: use every offer lifecycle control in the isolated owner demo

claim: Owners can preview and import offers from CSV, skip duplicates, and undo the import.
sandbox: upload a sample CSV containing two valid rows and one duplicate; import and undo

claim: Owners can export or delete one request without exposing other clients’ details.
sandbox: export and delete one of two requests, then verify the other remains

claim: Deletion retains only an internal request ID, action, and date in the audit record.
sandbox: delete a request and assert the audit API returns only request_id, action, and deleted_at

claim: The footer discloses that its original illustration was generated with Azure AI Foundry.
sandbox: open the landing page and assert the visible footer disclosure

claim: No product page loads analytics, advertising, remote fonts, or tracking scripts.
sandbox: record requests across landing, demo, legal, 404, private catalog, and authenticated owner routes; assert only product origin

claim: Sending a request does not charge the client, reserve stock, or create a purchase.
sandbox: submit a demo request and assert no checkout link or third-party request exists

claim: The product is free to use.
sandbox: assert the price fact and absence of checkout or subscription controls

claim: The product requires an internet connection to load.
sandbox: open a fresh browser context offline and assert the initial load fails

claim: PORT defaults to 8080, DATA_DIR selects the SQLite location, restarts retain data, and Entra settings accept environment overrides.
sandbox: start once without PORT; use a fresh custom data directory and Entra values; write data, restart, and read it back
